issues.description: bedrock-agentcore client is rebuilt per LLMContextFrame, paying TLS+auth setup cost every turn.
issues.detail: async with self._aws_session.client(...) opens a fresh client on every invocation, incurring handshake and credential resolution on the voice-pipeline hot path. Create the client once in setup/start and reuse it across turns, closing in cleanup. This is the per-turn latency users feel.

issues.description: default_response_to_output_transformer can raise JSONDecodeError on non-JSON lines and abort the stream.
issues.detail: json.loads is called with no try/except. A malformed SSE line, keepalive comment, or error payload propagates out of process_frame, leaving _output_response_open True and the matching LLMFullResponseEndFrame unsent. Wrap and log+skip, or return None on parse failure so the invariant 'every Start has a matching End' holds.

issues.description: Timeout-based response close races with the explicit end-of-stream close and is the wrong state machine.
issues.detail: _close_output_response_after_timeout flips _output_response_open and emits End on a 1s timer while process_frame also emits End at end-of-stream. The two paths can double-close or interleave Start/End across chunks. Emit Start once before the loop and End once after; drop the timer.

issues.description: SSE parsing is hand-rolled, non-RFC-compliant, and mixed into process_frame.
issues.detail: split('\n') with a hardcoded 6-char 'data: ' slice mishandles \r\n transports, ignores id/event/retry/comment fields, and treats every non-data line as a warning. Extract into a small generator that yields response lines so process_frame consumes lines cleanly, and handle SSE field syntax correctly.

issues.description: agentArn parameter name violates PEP 8 and the surrounding snake_case API.
issues.detail: Every other constructor argument is snake_case (aws_access_key, aws_region) but agentArn is camelCase and stored as self._agentArn. Rename to agent_arn (and _agent_arn) and translate to agentRuntimeArn at the AWS call site. Renaming a public kwarg later is a breaking change, so fix before this ships.

issues.description: default_context_to_payload_transformer silently drops non-text content parts and emits stray spaces.
issues.detail: ' '.join([part.get('text', '') for part in content]) yields empty strings for image or tool-result parts, producing leading/trailing/double spaces with no warning. Filter to text parts explicitly, or log when non-text parts are dropped so the contract is honest.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The processor is readable but has a first-cut feel: a per-invocation AWS client on a voice-pipeline hot path, an unguarded json.loads that can break the Start/End frame invariant, and a sleep-based response-close timer racing with the explicit end-of-stream close. Hand-rolled SSE parsing mixed into process_frame is brittle and not RFC-compliant, and agentArn breaks the surrounding snake_case API and should be renamed before shipping. Tighten the framing state machine, harden parsing, hoist the client, and fix the naming.
